formName: Step 3 - Technical Information - Works information for Water Licence Application
formDescription: Works are the physical equipment used to move the water from its source to where it will be used. This step requires selecting the major components of your works (e.g., pumps, pipelines, dugouts) and indicating their current construction status. There is also a field to provide additional details that may be relevant to the application, such as dimensions of dugouts or reservoirs, or specific information about the water system.

Selected_Access_Road.title: Access Road
Selected_Access_Road.description: The access road allows you to access your works, e.g. a dam or reservoir.

Status_Access Road.title: Access Road Status
Status_Access Road.description: Construction status of the access road.

Selected_Balancing_Reservoir.title: Balancing Reservoir
Selected_Balancing_Reservoir.description: A reservoir used to balance water levels.

Status_Balancing Reservoir.title: Balancing Reservoir Status
Status_Balancing Reservoir.description: Construction status of the balancing reservoir.

Selected_Back_flood_control_structure.title: Back flood control structure
Selected_Back_flood_control_structure.description: A structure to control water held back or forced back.

Status_Back flood control structure.title: Back flood control structure Status
Status_Back flood control structure.description: Construction status of the back flood control structure.

Selected_Culvert.title: Culvert
Selected_Culvert.description: A drain or pipe that allows water to flow under a road, railroad, trail, or similar obstruction.

Selected_Dam.title: Dam
Selected_Dam.description: A dam is any barrier that impounds water.

Selected_Deep_intake.title: Deep intake
Selected_Deep_intake.description: An intake located deep in the water.

Status_Deep intake.title: Deep intake Status
Status_Deep intake.description: Construction status of the deep intake.

Selected_Distribution_system.title: Distribution system
Selected_Distribution_system.description: A system which allows you to distribute water to multiple locations.

Status_Distribution system.title: Distribution system Status
Status_Distribution system.description: Construction status of the distribution system.

Selected_Ditch.title: Ditch
Selected_Ditch.description: A small or moderate depression created to channel water.

Selected_Diversion_channel.title: Diversion channel
Selected_Diversion_channel.description: A channel used to divert (redirect) water from one spot to another.

Status_Diversion channel.title: Diversion channel Status
Status_Diversion channel.description: Construction status of the diversion channel.

Selected_Dugout.title: Dugout
Selected_Dugout.description: A dugout is an excavation in the ground that holds water. Provide length, width and depth in the comments.

Selected_Erosion_Protection.title: Erosion Protection
Selected_Erosion_Protection.description: A material (i.e. riprap) that is used to prevent erosion of the stream bank and bed.

Selected_Fire_Suppression_System.title: Fire Suppression System
Selected_Fire_Suppression_System.description: A system used to suppress fire.

Status_Fire Suppression System.title: Fire Suppression System Status
Status_Fire Suppression System.description: Construction status of the fire suppression system.

Selected_Flow_measuring_device.title: Flow measuring device
Selected_Flow_measuring_device.description: A device that measures the flow of the water.

Status_Flow measuring device.title: Flow measuring device Status
Status_Flow measuring device.description: Construction status of the flow measuring device.

Selected_Hatchery.title: Hatchery
Selected_Hatchery.description: A hatchery is a facility where eggs are hatched under artificial conditions.

Selected_Heat_exchanger.title: Heat exchanger
Selected_Heat_exchanger.description: A device used to transfer heat from a fluid on one side of a barrier to a fluid on the other side.

Status_Heat exchanger.title: Heat exchanger Status
Status_Heat exchanger.description: Construction status of the heat exchanger.

Selected_Hydrant.title: Hydrant
Selected_Hydrant.description: An outlet from a water main with a valve attached from which fluid can be tapped.

Selected_Infiltration_chamber/gallery.title: Infiltration chamber/gallery
Selected_Infiltration_chamber/gallery.description: Low gradient closed conduit dug into an aquifer and collecting groundwater by gravity flow.

Status_Infiltration chamber/gallery.title: Infiltration chamber/gallery Status
Status_Infiltration chamber/gallery.description: Construction status of the infiltration chamber/gallery.

Selected_Irrigation_System.title: Irrigation System
Selected_Irrigation_System.description: A system to provide artificial application of water to lands for watering purposes.

Status_Irrigation System.title: Irrigation System Status
Status_Irrigation System.description: Construction status of the irrigation system.

Selected_Meter.title: Meter
Selected_Meter.description: A meter is used to measure how much water is used.

Selected_Outlet.title: Outlet
Selected_Outlet.description: An opening through which water flows out or is extracted from a reservoir or stream.

Selected_Pipe.title: Pipe
Selected_Pipe.description: A hollow cylinder used to convey water.

Selected_Pond.title: Pond
Selected_Pond.description: A body of standing water. Provide length, width and depth in the comments.

Selected_Pressure_tank.title: Pressure tank
Selected_Pressure_tank.description: A closed cylindrical container designed to store water under pressure.

Status_Pressure tank.title: Pressure tank Status
Status_Pressure tank.description: Construction status of the pressure tank.

Selected_Pump.title: Pump
Selected_Pump.description: A pump is a device that moves fluids by mechanical action.

Selected_Pumphouse.title: Pumphouse
Selected_Pumphouse.description: A structure that houses a pump.

Selected_Reservoir.title: Reservoir
Selected_Reservoir.description: An artificial lake or impoundment used to store water. Provide dimensions in the comments.

Selected_Spillway.title: Spillway
Selected_Spillway.description: A structure used for the controlled release of flows from a dam or levee.

Selected_Sprinklers.title: Sprinklers
Selected_Sprinklers.description: Irrigation from above by freely falling drops of water.

Selected_Standpipe.title: Standpipe
Selected_Standpipe.description: A freestanding pipe fitted with a tap installed outdoors to dispense water.

Selected_Sump.title: Sump
Selected_Sump.description: A low space that collects liquids or an infiltration basin used to manage surface runoff.

Selected_Treatment_facility/system.title: Treatment facility/system
Selected_Treatment_facility/system.description: A facility/system used in the process of making water suitable for its application.

Status_Treatment facility/system.title: Treatment facility/system Status
Status_Treatment facility/system.description: Construction status of the treatment facility/system.

Selected_Trough.title: Trough
Selected_Trough.description: A watering trough intended to provide drinking water to animals.

Selected_Tunnel.title: Tunnel
Selected_Tunnel.description: An underground passageway, completely enclosed except for openings for ingress and egress.

Selected_Weir.title: Weir
Selected_Weir.description: A barrier across a river designed to alter flow characteristics or measure discharge.

AdditionalWorksDetails.title: Please provide details about the works selected above, and your water system:
AdditionalWorksDetails.description: User-provided description of the system and specific details like dimensions for dugouts or reservoirs.

Selected_Control_Gate.title: Control Gate
Selected_Control_Gate.description: A gate which controls the flow of water.

Status_Control Gate.title: Control Gate Status
Status_Control Gate.description: Construction status of the control gate.

Selected_Diversion_structure.title: Diversion structure
Selected_Diversion_structure.description: A structure that allows you to divert (redirect) water from one spot to another.

Status_Diversion structure.title: Diversion structure Status
Status_Diversion structure.description: Construction status of the diversion structure.

Selected_Dyke.title: Dyke
Selected_Dyke.description: A barrier regulating or holding back water.

Selected_Fish_ladder.title: Fish ladder
Selected_Fish_ladder.description: A structure on or around an artificial barrier (e.g. a dam) that allows fish to migrate.

Status_Fish ladder.title: Fish ladder Status
Status_Fish ladder.description: Construction status of the fish ladder.

Selected_Head_Pond.title: Head Pond
Selected_Head_Pond.description: A reservoir designed to maintain required hydrostatic head. Please refer to the BC Dam Safety Regulation to ensure your proposed works do not constitute a dam.

Status_Head Pond.title: Head Pond Status
Status_Head Pond.description: Construction status of the head pond.

Selected_Intake.title: Intake
Selected_Intake.description: The intake is where you extract or divert the water from the source.

Selected_Penstock.title: Penstock
Selected_Penstock.description: A penstock is a sluice or gate or intake structure that controls water flow, or an enclosed pipe that delivers water to hydraulic turbines and sewerage systems.

Selected_Powerhouse.title: Powerhouse
Selected_Powerhouse.description: A structure that usually contains a generator to generate electrical power.

Selected_Screened_Intake.title: Screened Intake
Selected_Screened_Intake.description: A screened intake is an intake covered by a screen which prevents fish and other wildlife to be sucked into the intake.

Status_Screened Intake.title: Screened Intake Status
Status_Screened Intake.description: Construction status of the screened intake.

Selected_Settling_pond.title: Settling pond
Selected_Settling_pond.description: A settling basin, settling pond or decant pond are devices used to treat turbidity in industrial wastewater. Used to control water pollution in diverse industries.

Status_Settling pond.title: Settling pond Status
Status_Settling pond.description: Construction status of the settling pond.

Selected_Switch_Yard.title: Switch Yard
Selected_Switch_Yard.description: A switching station with incoming and outgoing feeders but without the transformer. Connects and disconnects lines on the grid.

Status_Switch Yard.title: Switch Yard Status
Status_Switch Yard.description: Construction status of the switch yard.

Selected_Tailrace.title: Tailrace
Selected_Tailrace.description: A channel which conveys water away from a water-wheel or turbine.

Selected_Transmission_Line.title: Transmission Line
Selected_Transmission_Line.description: A cable designed to carry electricity.

Status_Transmission Line.title: Transmission Line Status
Status_Transmission Line.description: Construction status of the transmission line.
